evaluation_policy: Adapt recipes using only the fixed development panel. Benchmark examples and labels never enter fitting. Freeze the lowest-KL pure-Q4 and mixed-precision candidates before final evaluation.
capture_policy: One request at a time, compact exact H128-basis diagonal and block-128 second moments before discarding generated raw captures.
quality_metrics: option KL and TV to BF16
reference_backend: llama.cpp CUDA, validated against CPU on 225 rows
native_evaluation: Two independent resident CPU processes, eight threads each, affinity 0-7 and 8-15; quality only, no speed claims. Each job resets recurrent/KV state.
selection: Adapted on development only: lowest option KL subject to macro accuracy no more than 0.5 percentage points below the development BF16 point estimate. Select pure Q4 and selective Q8 separately. This is a development guard, not a statistical equivalence claim. Final results do not tune recipes.
extended_search: 256 vs 1024 calibration requests; covariance damping 0.001, 0.01, 0.1; then Q8 tied head, Q8 recurrent a/b gates and both on the selected pure-Q4 recipe.; repeat all three Q8 ablations on the accuracy-guarded pure-Q4 recipe if different from the unconstrained KL winner.
